Overview

Vigo is a city in Galicia with a population of 295,000. Galicia’s largest city with a stunning natural harbor, beautiful islands, fresh seafood, and a strong maritime tradition. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
